questions.question: What silent World War I flying film won the first Academy Award for Best Picture?
questions.note: Outstanding Picture for 1927/28; Sunrise won a separate “Unique and Artistic Picture” prize that year.

questions.question: How many Oscars did Titanic win, tying Ben-Hur’s long-standing record?
questions.note: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King later also won 11, from 11 nominations.

questions.question: Who is the only person to win four acting Oscars?
questions.note: All four were Best Actress; Streep has the most acting nominations.

questions.question: Which Lord of the Rings film won Best Picture?
questions.note: It swept 11 Oscars in 2004, including Best Director for Peter Jackson.

questions.question: Who directed Schindler’s List, which won Best Picture in 1994?
questions.note: Spielberg’s first Best Director Oscar; he also won for Saving Private Ryan’s direction, not Picture.

questions.question: Which Bong Joon-ho film was the first non-English-language film to win Best Picture?
questions.note: South Korea, 2019 — it also won Best Director, Original Screenplay, and International Feature.

questions.question: Who won Best Actor for The Godfather and sent Sacheen Littlefeather to refuse the Oscar?
questions.note: Pacino was nominated for Supporting Actor that year; he later won Best Actor for Scent of a Woman.

questions.question: Which film won Best Picture at the 1999 Oscars, beating Saving Private Ryan?
questions.note: A famous “they robbed Spielberg” pub-quiz gripe.

questions.question: In 2017, which film was mistakenly announced as Best Picture before Moonlight was named the winner?
questions.note: Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway were handed the wrong envelope.

questions.question: Which filmmaker holds the record for the most Academy Awards won by a single person?
questions.note: 22 competitive Oscars, plus honorary awards — far ahead of anyone else.
